modeD.source: 49 CFR 571.108 (FMVSS 108, 10-1-23 ed.): Table XVIII UB2. Aimed as designed (mechanical, or the lower beam’s aim when combined: S10.18.9.3.1); a stand-alone visually aimed upper beam puts its maximum on H-V (S14.2.5.5.5.2) — set Aim to "peak" for that.
